title: TRON configuration: selection.yaml
description: Configured eligibility/ranking policy inputs applied at the canonical lifecycle's DETERMINE ELIGIBILITY / APPLY THRESHOLD / RESOLVE CONFLICT / RANK / SELECT stages (PID §7 steps 5-9). This schema declares the SHAPE of selection policy configuration only. It deliberately keeps 'conflict_policy' and 'existing_position_policy' as extensible enumerations rather than hard-coding PID §19's proposed resolutions as the only representable value, because DEC-OPEN-01 (conflicting candidate actions) and DEC-OPEN-02 (existing-position policy) remain OPEN Product Authority decisions. The concrete values used in config.example/selection.yaml are the PID's currently PROPOSED direction only, not a decided requirement — see 07-CONFIGURATION.md and 11-DECISIONS.md. Contract-owner of this file: WI-D (WO-TRON-D1). Ranking-rule and eligibility RULE BEHAVIOUR (what a named rule actually computes) is owned by 03-ARCHITECTURE.md / 04-TRADE-LIFECYCLE.md (WI-E/WI-F), not by this file, which only selects a rule by name and supplies its parameters.

confidence_string.description: Decimal string on the [0.0000, 1.0000] scale declared for falcon.trade_action.v1.confidence in 05-CONTRACTS.md. Kept identical here so a configured threshold is directly comparable to an incoming action's confidence value without unit conversion.

config_schema_version.description: Configuration schema major version for this file. Must equal "1". See 07-CONFIGURATION.md §2.

min_confidence.description: Minimum falcon.trade_action.v1.confidence value (inclusive) an OPEN candidate must carry to remain eligible at the APPLY THRESHOLD stage (PID §7 step 6). This is a configured threshold value only; it does not resolve DEC-OPEN-08 (cross-strategy confidence calibration), which remains OPEN.

ranking_rule.description: Name of the configured ranking rule applied at the RANK stage (PID §7 step 8) among eligible candidates for the same instrument. This file selects a rule by name only; the rule's behaviour is defined and catalogued elsewhere (WI-E/WI-F), not by this schema.

conflict_policy.description: Configured policy applied at the RESOLVE CONFLICT stage (PID §7 step 7) when qualifying LONG and SHORT candidate actions exist simultaneously for the same instrument. 'skip_instrument' corresponds to DEC-OPEN-01's currently PROPOSED initial policy (skip the instrument for that selection cycle) — it is not a decided requirement. The other enum members are named here so the schema does not foreclose a different eventual Product Authority answer; adding a further named policy later is an additive, non-breaking change under this file's config_schema_version.

existing_position_policy.description: Configured policy for whether TRON may open a new position on an instrument that already has an open position. 'one_position_per_instrument' corresponds to DEC-OPEN-02's currently PROPOSED MVP — it is not a decided requirement. 'allow_add_to_position' is named here only so the schema does not foreclose a different eventual Product Authority answer.
